entity.summary: South Korean centralized cryptocurrency exchange offering KRW trading markets and cryptocurrency deposit/withdrawal services. On 2026-11-06 it temporarily suspended deposits, normal withdrawals and trading after receiving a hacking-threat email, while arranging manually reviewed withdrawals through support; no asset theft from this threat was confirmed at the time. Separately, a September 2026 intrusion at operator Streami leaked personal information later confirmed to affect 2,009 people, and in November 2026 Streami missed the VASP re-filing deadline without presenting a financial restructuring plan to regulators.
entity.notes: On 2026-11-06 GOPAX suspended cryptocurrency deposits and ordinary withdrawals at 14:55 KST, followed by trading at 15:53 KST. Unfilled orders were canceled. The official help-center FAQ describes manual withdrawals to supported personal wallets, subject to review, and an undetermined trading restart date. Reporting on 2026-11-09 confirmed the continuing suspension. The 2026-11-18 review found no indexed confirmation of service resumption; current normal operation is not independently verified. No successful hack, asset loss or insolvency is established by the threat itself. The official FAQ was available through indexed excerpts; direct retrieval was unsuccessful. Earlier platform/API evidence is retained for identity, not proof of current transaction availability. A separate intrusion at Streami dated 2026-09-08 leaked personal information; GOPAX initially disclosed nine affected people in October 2026, but Financial Supervisory Service figures reported on 2026-11-18/19 put the affected count at 2,009 as of 2026-11-05, subject to change as the investigation proceeds. This intrusion is distinct from the November 6 hacking-threat email. On the regulatory side, reporting on 2026-11-22 said Streami had not presented a financial restructuring plan to financial regulators by the 2026-11-20 VASP re-filing deadline under the revised specified financial transaction information act, including how it would meet the 200% debt-ratio requirement; a senior regulatory official was quoted as saying GOPAX does not currently qualify to keep its VASP status. The 2026-11-28 review again found no confirmed resumption of normal service.

events.title: GOPAX temporarily halted deposits and standard withdrawals after hack threat
events.description: After a hacking-threat email, GOPAX suspended cryptocurrency deposits and ordinary web/app withdrawals at 14:55 KST. Manual withdrawals to supported personal wallets could be requested through customer support. No confirmed theft was reported from this threat.
events.notes: Preemptive security suspension, not evidence of a successful hack or permanent closure. The indexed GOPAX help-center FAQ restricts manual transfers to supported personal wallets; transfer to other exchanges was not supported at the time of the FAQ.

events.title: GOPAX suspended cryptocurrency trading and canceled outstanding orders
events.description: GOPAX halted cryptocurrency trading at 15:53 KST on 2026-11-06 and canceled all outstanding unfilled orders. The decision followed a hacking-threat email and security precautions, with no announced service-resumption date or confirmed theft from the reported threat.
events.notes: The event records a trading halt, not an established hack. The indexed official help-center FAQ confirms cancellation of outstanding orders and no predetermined service restart date.

events.title: Streami intrusion leaked personal information later confirmed to affect 2,009 people
events.description: An intrusion at Streami, the operator of GOPAX, dated 2026-09-08 leaked personal information. GOPAX initially disclosed in October 2026 that nine people, including customers and current and former employees, were affected. Financial Supervisory Service figures provided to a National Assembly member and reported on 2026-11-18/19 put the number of affected individuals at 2,009 as of 2026-11-05, with the count subject to change as the investigation proceeds. This intrusion is separate from the 2026-11-06 hacking-threat email that prompted the suspension of deposits, withdrawals and trading.
events.notes: Personal-information breach at the operator; no cryptocurrency asset theft from this intrusion is established by the cited reporting. The initially disclosed figure of nine people came from GOPAX's own October 2026 notice; the 2,009 figure is the regulator's tally reported in November 2026.

events.title: Streami missed VASP re-filing deadline without presenting financial restructuring plan
events.description: Under the revised Act on Reporting and Using Specified Financial Transaction Information, existing virtual asset service providers had to refile by 2026-11-20, including explaining how they would meet the requirement to keep the debt-to-equity ratio, excluding user deposits, at or below 200%. Reporting on 2026-11-22 said GOPAX operator Streami had not presented a financial restructuring plan to financial regulators by that deadline, and quoted a senior regulatory official as saying that under the current circumstances GOPAX does not qualify to keep its VASP status. Streami's disclosed financial statements showed liabilities of about 232 billion won against assets of about 13.5 billion won at the end of the previous year, a negative-equity position. The event is a regulatory follow-up to the continuing November 2026 service suspension; no license revocation had been announced at the time of the report.
events.notes: The 200% debt-ratio requirement itself applies from 2027-08-20 after a grace period, but operators were required to explain their compliance plans by the re-filing deadline. The exchange's VASP status had not been revoked at the time of reporting.

evidence.title: GOPAX official exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party GOPAX exchange endpoint is reachable and identifies the service as a Korean virtual-asset exchange.

evidence.title: GOPAX REST API
evidence.notes: Official GOPAX REST API documentation covers KRW trading pairs, balances, order queries, market and limit order placement, cancellation, trade history, deposits and withdrawals, tickers, order books, market statistics, charts, notices, WebSocket access, and a change history extending to 2026-06-02.

evidence.title: GOPAX API Documentation repository
evidence.notes: Official GOPAX GitHub organization repository points users to the GOPAX API documentation and provides first-party ownership linkage for the documented trading API.

evidence.title: 가상자산 출금 신청 방법 안내
evidence.notes: Indexed first-party FAQ identifies the November 6 web/app withdrawal and deposit suspension, manual withdrawal process, and supported personal-wallet limitation. Direct page retrieval was unsuccessful; indexed excerpt reviewed.

evidence.title: (LEAD) GOPAX suspends withdrawals, trading following hacking threats
evidence.notes: Indexed report confirms emergency withdrawal and trading suspension and that credibility of the threat was not yet verified.

evidence.title: 고팍스, 해킹 협박 메일 받고 출금·매매 중단 [크립토360]
evidence.notes: Indexed report gives withdrawal and trading suspension times, respectively 14:55 and 15:53 KST, and no restart date.

evidence.title: 고팍스, 해킹 협박 메일에 출금·매매 서비스 일시 중단
evidence.notes: Indexed report corroborates the 14:55 and 15:53 service suspensions and protective movement of assets to cold wallets.

evidence.title: 해킹 협박에 나흘째 멈춘 고팍스…출금은 수동, 재개는 미정
evidence.notes: Indexed follow-up report confirms continued trading and ordinary crypto-transfer suspension on November 9; manual withdrawals remained the route available. No later resumption confirmed by the review.

evidence.title: Gopax Trading Halt Hits Day 12, Stranding 24 Exclusive Coins
evidence.notes: Reports, under the heading 'Data Breach Victims Balloon From 9 to 2,009', that Financial Supervisory Service figures provided to Rep. Han Chang-min's office put the number of people whose personal information was leaked at Streami at 2,009 as of November 5, versus the nine people GOPAX disclosed the previous month; no separate notice was issued about the additional damage.

evidence.title: 고팍스 정보 유출 피해 2009명⋯당초 공지보다 2000명 늘어
evidence.notes: Dates the Streami intrusion to September 8 and reports the Financial Supervisory Service tally of 2,009 affected individuals as of November 5, noting the figure may change as the investigation proceeds.

evidence.title: Gopax Lacks Clear Path to Fix Negative Equity, Debt Ratio Rules
evidence.notes: Reports GOPAX failed to present a financial restructuring plan to financial regulators before the November 20 VASP re-filing deadline, and quotes a senior regulatory official that under the current circumstances it does not qualify to keep its VASP license; Streami had negative equity of about 218.5 billion won at the end of the previous year.

evidence.title: [단독] '부채비율 200%' 규제 못넘나...고팍스, 재무개선 계획 안갯속
evidence.notes: Korean-language original of the Decenter report: GOPAX had not presented a financial-structure improvement plan to regulators by the re-filing deadline, borrowing from its largest shareholder at over 15% annual interest instead of receiving a capital injection.
